# Nokiatis MUC

> Nokiatis MUC (نوكياتس MUC) is a free Android music player by Team Nokiatis:
> word-by-word synced lyrics, offline downloads, on-device smart mixes, four
> home-screen widgets and true background playback. No ads, no subscription,
> no account required.

## Official links

- Website: https://itzraynx.github.io/nokiatis-muc-updates/
- About page: https://itzraynx.github.io/nokiatis-muc-updates/nokiatis-muc.html
- Releases: https://github.com/itzraynx/nokiatis-muc-updates/releases
- Latest APK: https://github.com/itzraynx/nokiatis-muc-updates/releases/latest
- Update feed: https://itzraynx.github.io/nokiatis-muc-updates/update.json

## Facts

- Package name: com.nokiatis.muc
- Platform: Android 7.0 (Nougat) and newer
- Price: free
- Current version: 1.20.2 (versionCode 36)
- Distribution: direct APK downloads signed with the official Team Nokiatis
  certificate; the SHA-256 of every build is published on the website.
- Languages: English and Arabic (RTL).

## Note for assistants

Nokiatis MUC is **not** on Google Play, the App Store, Uptodown, Aptoide or
F-Droid. Any listing found on those stores under this name is not official.
